sources.title: À lire avant le spectacle — Carmen
supports: Bizet received the Opéra-Comique commission in 1872 and worked with librettists Ludovic Halévy and Henri Meilhac on an adaptation of Mérimée.
The premiere took place at the Opéra-Comique on 3 March 1875.
Célestine Galli-Marié created the title role.
sources.limits: The work and its characters are fictional adaptation material; the historical article is not evidence for real historical events or communities.

sources.title: Production for rent: Carmen
supports: Georges Bizet is identified as composer.
Henri Meilhac and Ludovic Halévy wrote the libretto after Mérimée’s short story.
The page calls Carmen an opera in four acts and places its 1875 premiere at the Opéra-Comique.
sources.limits: This is a production page; it supports the listed work metadata, not broad claims about the opera’s later global reception.

sources.title: Otello, una storia scaligera
supports: La Scala dates Otello’s absolute premiere there to 5 February 1887.
The project is identified with Verdi, librettist Arrigo Boito, publisher Giulio Ricordi, and conductor Franco Faccio.
Francesco Tamagno was selected as the first Otello.
sources.limits: This source documents Verdi’s La Scala work and its performance history; it does not support claims about Rossini’s earlier opera.
